description: Saves one or more target-language words or phrases from the conversation to the user's MindDory deck. A new word becomes a flashcard in the "Chat Discoveries" folder; a word already in the deck gets the new sentence recorded as another encounter. `lang` (ISO code of the word's own language) is required and the call is rejected without it; the target language is never guessed. `words` takes several items at once; `gloss` is a short source-language translation and `context` the sentence the word appeared in. Items without a letter (numbers, punctuation), items shorter than 3 characters (CJK and Hangul exempt) and common stop words in English, German, Spanish, French and Czech are skipped. `source_lang` defaults to the user's deck.

context.description: The sentence where the word appeared.

folder_id.description: Optional: id of the folder new cards go into (from list_folders). It must be a folder in the same language as `lang`. Omit it and the user's default folder is used, or the "Chat Discoveries" folder when they have none. Words already in the deck stay where they are.

gloss.description: Short translation in the source language.

lang.description: Required. ISO code of the captured word's own language (en, de, es, zh, ...). The call is rejected without it.

source_lang.description: ISO code of the user's native/source language. Optional — defaults to the source language of the user's existing deck.

words.description: Batch capture. Each entry is {word, gloss?, context?}.

name: capture_word
title: Capture word
